# Briefing for the Council

This briefing is a short summary for the Council before its October session. The pilot ran for eight weeks and the table below shows what happened to the main measures.

| Measure | Before | During pilot |
|---|---:|---:|
| Average peak-hour load | 94% | 71% |
| Average interval between buses at peak | 10 min | 6.5 min |
| Passenger satisfaction (out of 5) | 2.7 | 3.9 |

The numbers come from the project team and are not audited. The Council will decide later in the year.
